title: Explicit degree-sensitive lower bounds for homogeneous noncommutative circuits

standard_prerequisites.name: Elementary homogeneous circuit algebra, de Bruijn word existence and polynomial linear algebra
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Full local measure, weighted-derivative and restriction proofs plus original bibliography retained.

core_obligations: Bound the interval coefficient-polynomial measure of a homogeneous noncommutative circuit.
Construct hard words and lift the degree-sensitive bound through simultaneous partial derivatives.
difficulty_reason: Uses the dimension of families of consecutive subword coefficient polynomials, de Bruijn words and a simultaneous-partial-derivative construction to obtain degree-sensitive explicit lower bounds. Bivariate monomial and general-variable regimes are bundled as one principal lower-bound construction.

dedup.scope: Root checked complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active lines for the exclusive DOI without neighbors. Two principal constructions counted: explicit degree-sensitive hard polynomial family and ordered-symmetric quadratic lower bound. Bivariate/multivariate regimes are bundled; derivative and measure support lemmas and upper-bound contrasts are uncounted.
